geometry.parent_geometry_scope: same golden sites and oriented adjacency; scalar masses, conductances and plaquette law are not reused

law.midpoint_covariance: sum of midpoint orbital outer products, a positive contraction; not a normalized 15-particle Slater state or a continuous-time midpoint
law.operator_boundary: nonzero local charge variance excludes operator Gauss for the declared classical E
law.orbital_state: one normalized occupied orbital for each distinct internal component; 15 orthogonal blocks
law.readout_current: instantaneous current uses checkpoint orbitals; factor_current registers use that edge factor midpoint
law.schedule: one ascending sweep over all 144 edges; each factor consumes the current endpoint orbitals

premises: Prepared q5 golden addresses, oriented nearest-neighbor graph and fixed Pauli frame.
Registered all-left-Weyl multiplets with one generation; CAR and occupied Slater state are supplied.
Uniform hopping k=1 and local Cayley duration dt=1/2 are declared independently of scalar conductances.
Compact U1 link acts with integer charge q=6Y; its angle and electric momentum use that declared normalization.
Only number-conserving hypercharge hopping factors evolve; Higgs, Yukawa, gauge-electric and plaquette factors are absent.
Electric momentum is a classical mean-field coordinate driven by the CAR expectation current.
Exact rational arithmetic, protected records and classical read/write access are supplied.
